sloka: सो ऽधिरुह्य नरव्याघ्र: पादुके ह्यवरुह्य च ।प्रायच्छत् सुमहातेजा भरताय महात्मने ॥ २.११२.२२॥
transliteration: so 'dhiruhya naravyāghra: pāduke hyavaruhya ca ।prāyacchat sumahātejā bharatāya mahātmane ॥ 2.112.22॥

translations.english: Rama, the best of men, one with great brilliance, put on and then put off the sandals and presented them to the magnanimous Bharata.
